entities.summary: Adolfo de Carolis was an Italian painter, xylographer, illustrator and photographer. He is generally associated with Art Nouveau, although many of his works could also be classified as Symbolism. Adolfo de Carolis was a painters & sculptors from Montefiore dell'Aso (1874-01-06, Montefiore dell'Aso–1928-02-07). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
